name: lineage-studio
description: LineageStudio - a lineage-driven multi-model agent studio

scripts.dev:rts: concurrently -n backend,rts -c blue,green "npm:dev:backend" "npm --workspace experiments/rts-app run dev"
scripts.build: npm --workspace backend run build && npm --workspace frontend run build && npm --workspace experiments/rts-app run build
scripts.typecheck: npm --workspace backend run typecheck && npm --workspace frontend run typecheck && npm --workspace experiments/rts-app run typecheck
